title: Small-section realization of ordinary atlas module tuples
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F an algebraic space over S with its small etale site and structure sheaf [def-trf-algebraic-space], and I : Type u an index type in the scheme universe. Let V_i be objects of this site, with no joint-surjectivity assumption. Let R_ij be schemes over S equipped with projections representing V_i times_F V_j as presheaf pullback squares. Let M_i be ordinary invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. Suppose alpha_ij : p_2^* M_j isomorphic to p_1^* M_i are ordinary module isomorphisms, with pullback and canonical transport as in [def-pc-module-pullback] and [def-sfb-ordinary-etale-identification]. Assume their restrictions along every diagonal are identities and their transitions compose on every triple test scheme. Then there exists a module sheaf N in F.Modules, with section sets in Type u, and ordinary etale identifications e_i of N with M_i [def-sfb-ordinary-etale-identification]. On every test object T with arrows a:T to V_i, b:T to V_j and r:T to R_ij respecting the two projections, e_i applied to the transported alpha_ij(s) equals e_j(s), for every section s of b^* M_j. No local-freeness conclusion for N, covering hypothesis, or assertion on descended morphisms is included.

proof.text: Associate tensor-section sheaves to the invertible M_i on the localized chart sites. The scheme comparison, with its unit-normalized identity and composition comparisons, transports alpha and its two coherence laws to local module sheaves. The values remain u-small.

proof.text: Use the literal compatible-tuples construction: at W, take tuples of sections on W times_F V_i satisfying the transition equation on every double overlap. The index types I and I times I and each section set are u-small, so this construction has u-small section values. Define operations and restrictions coordinatewise, as in the tuple-sheaf lemma; sheaf limits are sectionwise. This is the u-small section specialization of that construction, not an arbitrary witness chosen to define data.

proof.text: Evaluate a tuple on the graph in its own chart. The inverse uses the transported transitions on each coordinate. The diagonal law proves one inverse identity, and the (k,i) tuple equation pulled back along the graph proves the other. The cocycle makes the inverse tuple compatible. Linearity and naturality of tensor sections supply the ordinary etale identifications. Pull back the (i,j) tuple equation along the pair of graphs to obtain precisely the specified transition identity, including self-overlaps. For an empty index type the module is zero.

theorem exists_ordinary_atlas_tuple_realization
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : AlgebraicSpace S) {I : Type u} (V : I → F.EtaleSite)
    (R : I → I → Over S)
    (p₁ : ∀ i j : I, R i j ⟶ (V i).obj.left)
    (p₂ : ∀ i j : I, R i j ⟶ (V j).obj.left)
    (hR : ∀ i j : I, IsPullback (yoneda.map (p₁ i j)) (yoneda.map (p₂ i j))
      (V i).obj.hom (V j).obj.hom)
    (M : ∀ i : I, (F.etaleForget.obj (V i)).Modules)
    (hM : ∀ i : I, Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible (M i))
    (α : ∀ i j : I,
    (tensorPullback (p₂ i j).left).obj (M j) ≅ (tensorPullback (p₁ i j).left).obj (M i))
    (hdiag : ∀ (i : I) (d : (V i).obj.left ⟶ R i i)
    (h₁ : d ≫ p₁ i i = 𝟙 (V i).obj.left) (h₂ : d ≫ p₂ i i = 𝟙 (V i).obj.left),
    atlasTransitionOver (M i) (M i) (p₁ i i) (p₂ i i) (α i i)
      d (𝟙 (V i).obj.left) (𝟙 (V i).obj.left) h₁ h₂ =
      Iso.refl ((tensorPullback (𝟙 (V i).obj.left.left)).obj (M i)))
    (hcocycle : ∀ (i j k : I) (T : Over S)
    (a : T ⟶ (V i).obj.left) (b : T ⟶ (V j).obj.left) (c : T ⟶ (V k).obj.left)
    (rᵢⱼ : T ⟶ R i j) (rⱼₖ : T ⟶ R j k) (rᵢₖ : T ⟶ R i k)
    (hᵢⱼ₁ : rᵢⱼ ≫ p₁ i j = a) (hᵢⱼ₂ : rᵢⱼ ≫ p₂ i j = b)
    (hⱼₖ₁ : rⱼₖ ≫ p₁ j k = b) (hⱼₖ₂ : rⱼₖ ≫ p₂ j k = c)
    (hᵢₖ₁ : rᵢₖ ≫ p₁ i k = a) (hᵢₖ₂ : rᵢₖ ≫ p₂ i k = c),
    atlasTransitionOver (M i) (M k) (p₁ i k) (p₂ i k) (α i k)
      rᵢₖ a c hᵢₖ₁ hᵢₖ₂ =
    atlasTransitionOver (M j) (M k) (p₁ j k) (p₂ j k) (α j k)
      rⱼₖ b c hⱼₖ₁ hⱼₖ₂ ≪≫
    atlasTransitionOver (M i) (M j) (p₁ i j) (p₂ i j) (α i j)
      rᵢⱼ a b hᵢⱼ₁ hᵢⱼ₂) :
    ∃ (N : F.Modules),
    ∃ (e : ∀ i : I, OrdinaryEtaleIdentification F (V i) N (M i)),
        ∀ (i j : I) (T : F.EtaleSite) (a : T ⟶ V i) (b : T ⟶ V j)
          (r : T.obj.left ⟶ R i j)
          (h₁ : r ≫ p₁ i j = a.hom.left) (h₂ : r ≫ p₂ i j = b.hom.left)
          (s : ((tensorPullback (F.etaleForget.map b)).obj (M j)).val.obj (op ⊤)),
          (e i).app T a
            (((atlasTransitionOver (M i) (M j) (p₁ i j) (p₂ i j) (α i j)
              r a.hom.left b.hom.left h₁ h₂).hom.app ⊤) s) = (e j).app T b s
